description: Print Hive is software for operating Bambu Lab 3D print farms, including fleet monitoring, job queueing, material workflows, and AI-assisted control. Its product connects printers and operators through a centralized management platform.
summary: Print Hive exposes two developer surfaces on api.printhiv3d.com: a REST API at `/v1` and a streamable HTTP MCP server at `/v1/mcp`; both are authenticated, with REST accepting API key or bearer token and MCP accepting OAuth, API key, or bearer token.
